text:
hi! i have a tool which creates songs given lyrics, instructions for the sound, bpm (optional), length (optional), seed (optional, seeds the RNG if you want to keep it the same for similar sounds across songs), and title (optional).

would you like to create a song? about anything in the world you'd like :)

Oh, I'd love to. Here's what I'd make:

---

**Title:** This One Goes Out

**BPM:** 68

**Length:** ~3:30

**Seed:** 3330

**Sound instructions:** Late-night Americana soul. Dusty upright piano playing simple triads, brushed snare, upright bass walking slow, pedal steel sighing in the gaps. Warm tape hiss and a little room noise throughout — it should sound like it's coming *out of* a radio, not off a record. Lead vocal is low, close-mic'd, unpolished, a bit of gravel, like someone talking more than singing. No big build; let the Hammond organ swell in on the last chorus and then pull back for the outro. Ends with the instruments dropping out one at a time until there's just hiss.

---

**Lyrics**

*(Verse 1)*
Three a.m. and the tower is humming
Coffee gone cold in a paper cup
Forty miles of highway, nobody coming
Just a little red light saying I'm still up

*(Verse 2)*
There's a nurse on the fourth floor writing her numbers
A man on I-80 with two hours to go
A girl in a parking lot, crying, and nobody knows her —
Well, I don't know her either, but I know

*(Chorus)*
This one goes out to whoever's still awake
To the ones the dark forgot to take
You don't know my name, I don't know yours
But we're stuck on the same side of the same closed doors
So this one goes out to you

*(Verse 3)*
I've got a stack of records and a dying transmitter
And a range of about a hundred miles
And I have never once believed I'm making it better
But I've been told it helps, sometimes, a while

*(Chorus)*
This one goes out to whoever's still awake
To the ones the dark forgot to take
Nobody's calling, and that's alright
Somebody's out there — I can feel it in the night
So this one goes out to you

*(Bridge)*
Somewhere a kid falls asleep with the radio on
And doesn't hear the end of the song
And that's the whole reason
That's the whole reason
That's the whole reason I'm here

*(Outro)*
Sun's coming up on the edge of the dial
Signal getting smaller, I'll be gone in a while
Hang on till the morning, that's all I ask you to do —
And this one goes out to you

---

I picked it because I like the idea of somebody transmitting into the dark without knowing who's on the other end, and doing it anyway. Feels like the most honest thing a person can do. Let me know how it turns out — and I'm happy to write another in a totally different genre if you want to hear what the tool does with, say, a furious 160bpm punk song about parking tickets.
